title: Post-incident: backfill evals and config-change guardrails for model config rollout
creator: Arielle Park
description:
Summary: After a customer-reported drop in summary quality for a hosted model variant during a routine rollout, we traced the regression to a combined set of config changes (quantization preset + kernel scheduling heuristic) that interacted poorly with short-context prompt templates. The incident caused increased error rates for two customers and triggered a support page escalation. This ticket captures the postmortem follow-ups: backfill targeted evals, add CI pre-deploy checks for config/model changes, and build guardrails to prevent silent regressions during rollouts.

Scope: add small focused eval suites covering short-context and few-shot patterns, wire pre-deploy gating that runs these evals for any change to model/config catalog entries, update the rollout checklist and console alerting, and add an automated rollback trigger when eval thresholds are violated in canaries.
root_cause_summary: Root cause is a regression introduced by changing the kernel selection heuristic in combination with a new quantized model profile. For short context prompts (<=128 tokens) the kernel path produced slightly different floating point rounding behavior post-quantization, which pushed the model over our quality regression threshold for a subset of evaluation prompts. There was no pre-deploy eval that exercised this prompt distribution, and our CI did not run the lightweight evals for catalog/config changes.
actions: A: Add 'short-context-regression' eval suite (50 prompts) with golden outputs and automated thresholds - owner: Mateo Ruiz - due: 2026-03-12
B: Integrate eval suite into catalog-config CI (pre-deploy gate) - owner: Lina Chen - due: 2026-03-19
C: Create canary-eval CI job applied during rollout policy (runs on canary hosts) - owner: DevOps Team (Prakash) - due: 2026-03-22
D: Add dashboard and alert for eval delta > 2% absolute on production metrics during canary - owner: Observability (Maya) - due: 2026-03-18
E: Document rollback criteria and add automatic rollback hook for model rollouts when canary evals fail - owner: Mateo Ruiz - due: 2026-03-26
acceptance_criteria: New eval suite exists in evals repo and runs in < 3 minutes
Pre-deploy CI job fails on regressions beyond configured thresholds for any model/config change
Canary rollout job executes canary-eval and triggers rollback when thresholds breached
Dashboard surfaces per-model eval deltas and a customer-facing incident link when triggered
Post-deploy runbook updated with steps and owners

notes: Trade-offs: Running full evals on every config change is too slow for developer iteration. We designed a short targeted suite to catch this class of regressions (short-context + quantization interactions).
We chose automated rollback on canary failure to reduce blast radius; this requires better observability to avoid false positives. We'll tune thresholds over 2 cycles.
Consider adding a 'simulate-kernel-path' flag in runtime that can be used in unit tests to exercise alternate kernels cheaply.
